galleryInterface.implementation: Existing SDK controls mounted through GalleryControls.tsx; navigation dismiss paint, timelines, geometry and input belong to Rust.

rules: Every official React control reaches the shared Rust SDK adapter.
Every runtime NodeKind has reviewed origin and Rust implementation references.
No frontend HTML/ARIA control substitutes or navigation dismiss handlers.
React control adapters contain only approved DOM content hosts; no frontend painting, animation or input capture.
implementationBoundary.limitations: Static checks enforce known boundaries and reject unreviewed additions; runtime regressions and code review remain necessary for semantic correctness.

reactAdapters.NavigationViewContent: React projection of a named Rust NavigationView slot; no independent control behavior.
reactAdapters.Frame: Microsoft.UI.Xaml.Controls.Frame: Rust journal, cache and motion with a React DOM content host; sources in references/frame-sources.json.
reactAdapters.WinUIProvider: WASM runtime ownership and React context, not a visual control.
reactAdapters.SceneView: Canvas rendering host, not a visual control.
reactAdapters.SceneNavigationView: React adapter to the existing NavigationView inside a shared scene.
reactAdapters.SceneFrame: React adapter to the Rust Frame node in a shared scene.
reactAdapters.RichInline: Named Rust Grid content slot inside a RichTextBlock, not another text renderer.

notes: Origins classify APIs, not implementation completeness or native visual parity.
WrapPanel follows the pinned Gallery CommunityToolkit source, not an invented Microsoft control.
Scene/Panel/runtime/renderer and host bridges are infrastructure, not additional user-facing controls.
Historical validation records retain the prototype name as evidence of the old run.
